title: Find Longest Awesome Substring
summary: Given a string, determine the length of the longest substring that can be transformed into a palindrome through any number of swaps.
statement: Given a string, determine the length of the longest substring that can be transformed into a palindrome through any number of swaps.
constraints: Return the longest substring whose characters can be rearranged into a palindrome, meaning at most one digit has odd frequency.
hints: Represent prefix digit-count parity as a ten-bit mask.
Equal masks delimit a substring with all even counts.
Masks differing by one bit delimit a substring with exactly one odd count.
Store only the earliest index for each mask to maximize every candidate length.
editorial: Store only the earliest index for each mask to maximize every candidate length.

tests.explanation: Substring 24241 has only digit four with odd frequency, so the maximum length is five.
No length-two-or-more substring can form a palindrome, so the answer is one.
